page_note: Pure cosmological substrate throughout — describes the binding of the archons/firstborn upon the Wheel of stars and the sphere, the mechanics of light-extraction (cold/heat, ascending/descending), and the cosmic registers bound within him (powers, garment of love-of-strife, kingship, desire, property, animals). Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system. No dialogue frame, no exhortation, no institutional content, no polemic. Teaching purity 1.000 confirms the reading.
